newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern extends Conrail offer.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern extends Conrail offer.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it is extending its previously announced tender offer for shares of Conrail Inc through 12:00 midnight EST (0500 GMT) on April 18.
The company said the offer had been scheduled to expire on March 12, unless extended.
Norfolk said it expects to negotiate with CSX Corp a comprehensive settlement of the issues confronting the two suitors consistent with the proposal submitted by Norfolk Southern last month.
However, while negotiations are pending, Norfolk intends to amend its tender offer to run coextensive with CSX's offer.
It continues to offer $115 cash per share for all shares of Conrail. Norfolk said that, as of March 7, about 1,056,000 Conrail shares had been tendered and not withdrawn.
